$comment: Wording layer. Contains NO card names and NO faction names — those live in the theme and are injected via tokens, so re-theming can never break another card's text. Tokens: {icon:<name>} inline glyph; {card:<id>} card name from the theme; {faction:<id>.<form>} faction label from the theme, where <form> is any form the theme defines (one, other, and for German also case forms).

effects.1.b: {icon:move} Move this card 1 space towards the center of the path.
effects.3.a: {icon:send} Send the {icon:lowest} lowest {icon:adjacent} adjacent card to the beginning of the path.
effects.4.a: {icon:moveBack} Move the {icon:lowest} lowest {icon:adjacent} adjacent card back 2 spaces.
effects.5.a: {icon:swap} Swap this card with a card 2 spaces away.
effects.6.a: {icon:send} Send the {icon:lowest} lowest {icon:adjacent} adjacent card to the space before {card:2}.
effects.6.b: If it is {card:2}, {icon:move} move {card:2} 2 spaces towards {card:0}, even if it moves beyond it.
effects.7.a: {icon:move} Choose a card 3 spaces away and move it 1 space.
effects.7.b: {icon:move} Choose a card 2 spaces away and move it 2 spaces.
effects.7.c: {icon:move} Choose a card 1 space away and move it 3 spaces.
effects.8.a: {icon:moveBack} Move any {icon:adjacent} adjacent card back 2 spaces.
effects.9.a: {icon:swap} Swap this card with a card 3 spaces away.
effects.10.a: {icon:swap} Swap this card with any {icon:adjacent} adjacent card.
effects.11.a: {icon:move} Move the {icon:lowest} lowest {icon:adjacent} adjacent card 2 spaces towards {card:2}, even if it moves beyond it.
effects.11.b: If it is {card:2}, {icon:move} move {card:2} 2 spaces towards {card:0}, even if it moves beyond it.
effects.13.a: {icon:moveBack} Move any {icon:adjacent} adjacent card back 3 spaces.
effects.14.a: {icon:swap} Swap this card with a card 4 spaces away.

objective.title: Objective
body: Walk along a Path of 14 cards, made up of 8 {faction:true.other} and 6 {faction:fake.other}.
Take {card:0} from the beginning of the Path to the end and connect with {card:D}.

sections.heading: End of the Game
items: You win if, at the end of the {faction:fake.other} turn, {card:0} is next to {card:D}.
You lose if {card:0} is destroyed, or if you cannot activate any {faction:true.one}.

setup.title: Setup
items: Shuffle the 14 remaining cards and form the Path by placing them from left to right.
Place {card:0} at the beginning of the Path (left).
Place {card:D} at the end of the Path (right).

turn.title: How to Play
items: Player turn: choose any {faction:true.one} within the Path and activate it by resolving 1 of its effects.
{faction:fake.other} turn: each {faction:fake.one} within the Path is activated from lowest to highest (1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 11).
Begin a new round with the player turn.

entries.text: Immediately to its left or right (1 space away).
Move in any direction (left or right).
Move directly to the indicated position.
Take out of the Path and therefore out of the game.
Card with the lowest number in its top left corner.

clarifications.title: Clarifications
items: You may activate the same {faction:true.one} in consecutive rounds.
A few {faction:true.other} have multiple effects. When activating them, choose only one effect and resolve it.
If the movement from an effect cannot be carried out completely, you can't resolve that effect.
If you cannot activate any {faction:true.one}, you lose immediately.
When activating a {faction:fake.one}, resolve its top effect. If unable, the bottom effect offers an alternative. If neither can be resolved, ignore that card.
The numbers of the effects are exact, unless preceded by "up to". Example: "up to 2" means 1 or 2.
No card can move back beyond the first position of the Path.
No card can move beyond {card:D}. You need to move {card:0} exactly to the position on the left side of {card:D}.
